name: o90425

schema.title: Ansible Inventory
schema.description: Ansible Inventory for the script inventory plugin

hosts.description: list of hosts that are part of this group

vars.description: Variables to assign to hosts that are part of this group

^\\w$.description: Vars for this hosts in this group

children.description: list of groups that are children of this group, their hosts will be added to this group

_meta.description: Key that avoids calling the script per host

hostvars.description: Each key is a hostname and the value is a dictionary of the variables for that host

description:
The inventory is organized into two primary groups. Group **a** contains the web servers **web1** and **web2** and inherits all members of its child group **b**. Within group a a variable namespace called **p** defines the login user for the group as `ansible_user=ubuntu`. Group **b**, which is listed as a child of a, hosts the database server **db1**; its own variable namespace **q** sets the connection port with `ansible_port=22`. No further child groups are defined under b.

On a host‑specific level, the meta section provides additional variables. Host **c** is associated with a variable block **x**, which specifies `ansible_host=192.168.1.10` and marks the environment as `prod`. Host **d** uses a block **y**, assigning `ansible_host=192.168.1.11` and labeling the environment as `staging`.
